classes.description: List of hardware classes to report on (e.g., cpu, memory, disk). If empty, all classes are reported unless restricted by other means.

disabled_tests.description: List of detection tests to disable (e.g., dmi, pci, usb, ide).

dump_file.description: Path to a file to dump the collected hardware information into.

enabled_tests.description: List of detection tests to explicitly enable.

notime.description: Whether to exclude volatile attributes like timestamps.

numeric.description: Whether to display numeric IDs for PCI and USB devices.

output_format.description: Desired output format: json, xml, html, short, or businfo.

sanitize.description: Whether to remove potentially sensitive information from output.
